title: Following Error — Elevated But Within Limit
description: Following error P016 = {val} mm is elevated above advisory threshold (0.02 mm) but below halt limit. Trend over last 100 moves: increasing.
probable_cause: Servo loop gain reduction or mechanical friction increase.
diagnostic_steps: Run test cycle and log P016 per block
remedy: Log and monitor. Schedule servo re-tuning if trend continues.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
